messages:
pagerbot: ALERT: High GPU OOM rate on prod-cluster-7 for model-7B-prefill. 48 container restarts in last 10m. Paging darren_oncall.

darren_oncall: Ack, oncall here. Investigating.

anita_sre: I'm joining. Any customer-facing errors yet?

mike_runtime: Seeing repeated container restarts. Kernel log shows CUDA OOM during prefill. Looks correlated to requests with very large context windows (~>150k tokens).

mike_runtime: dmesg excerpt:
```\n[12345.678901] NVRM: GPU at 0000:06:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[12345.678912] python: segfault at 7f8... ip 00007f8... sp 00007fff...
[12345.678930] cuda: out of memory trying to allocate 4.0 GiB
[12346.000000] containerd: container exited with status 137
```

lisa_support: Customer ACME reported spikes of 500s and timeouts on /generate around 09:12 UTC, multiple retries. Ticket #INC-4621 opened.

katie_product: @kate_product here — any customer impact estimate? We need an external note if >5% of requests impacted.

darren_oncall: Quick triage: root cause likely prefill paths allocating full KV + prefill buffers for massive prompts, pushing GPU mem over alloc budget and causing container kill. Workaround options: 1) trim prefill to N tokens 2) route large-context traffic to nodes with oversubscription disabled 3) fallback to smaller model variant for pinned customers.

anita_sre: I'll roll a config change to enforce a soft cap on prefill tokens at the proxy layer for the cluster (drop/413 for >200k tokens) — rolling now to 3 nodes for canary.

mike_runtime: Adding a runtime hotpatch to enable aggressive KV eviction during prefill and to apply a per-request memory cap. Pushing to canary nodes.

darren_oncall: Implemented temporary routing rule to divert legacy heavy requests to dedicated pool with no packing. Also enabling per-route rate limit for /generate long_context key.

lisa_support: Noted — drafting customer notification. Suggested message: apology, cause, immediate mitigations (routing + short-term cap), recommended workaround (shorten prompt or use streaming + partial context).

anita_sre: Canary looks good: nodes accepted config, canary 3/3 healthy. Restarts on those nodes dropped to 0.

mike_runtime: Cluster-wide rollout started. Monitoring GPU OOM metric and container restart rate.

pagerbot: METRIC: container_restart_rate on prod-cluster-7 peaked at 9/min at 09:15 UTC, down to 0.6/min at 09:28 UTC after mitigations.

darren_oncall: Observed customer error volume drop ~85% after routing/cap; ACME support ticket updated.

kate_product: Thanks — please keep me posted. We'll send a brief external note once you confirm stability.

anita_sre: Stability looks OK but one pinned customer still hitting OOMs (using an older pinned model version that ignores autoscaling). Creating a follow-up task to contact them and offer a model bump or temporary dedicated capacity.

darren_oncall: Handoff: I'll continue monitoring for next 30m then hand to day oncall. Filed follow-up incident ticket INC-4621-FWUP with remediation tasks and timeline.

lisa_support: Customer note drafted and queued for approval: short outage explanation, mitigation steps we took, recommended actions for customers, ETA for permanent fix (postmortem + config to limit prefill costs).

anita_sre: Tagging for postmortem: @mike_runtime, @darren_oncall, @lisa_support. Will collect logs and sample offending request IDs.

darren_oncall: OK closing pager for now. If any spike >2/min, re-page. :white_check_mark:

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: paging paused at 09:40 UTC — monitoring enabled.
